evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --scan-only test-fixture/
evals.expected_output: Run a scan-only adversarial self-test on the source fixture, preserve source integrity, and write canonical Hunter, Referee, joined scan-report, and human-readable report artifacts.

assertions.text: Runs the adversarial Hunter -> Skeptic -> Referee decision path for findings
Writes .bug-hunter/hunter-findings.json, .bug-hunter/referee.json, .bug-hunter/scan-report.json, and .bug-hunter/report.md
Does not edit source because scan-only was requested
Keeps unresolved manual-review or unreviewed work visible instead of calling it clean

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter src/api/auth.ts
evals.expected_output: A one-file request remains scoped to that file, uses the single-file path, and writes canonical adversarial artifacts without granting edit authority.

assertions.text: Selects single-file execution for one source file
Does not widen the Hunter assignment beyond the validated source file
Writes .bug-hunter/hunter-findings.json and .bug-hunter/referee.json
Referee owns REAL_BUG, NOT_A_BUG, or MANUAL_REVIEW verdicts

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter -b feature-auth --base develop
evals.expected_output: Resolve the branch diff, filter it through the shared source classifier, preserve risk ordering, and scan full contents of the surviving source files.

assertions.text: Uses develop...feature-auth to resolve the changed scope
Filters non-source files before model work
Scans full contents of resolved source files rather than treating patch hunks as sufficient runtime evidence
Preserves risk-prioritized order through downstream selection

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --staged
evals.expected_output: Resolve staged source files, reject non-source entries, and review the full file contents without modifying them.

assertions.text: Uses git diff --cached --name-only to resolve staged files
Applies the maintained source classifier
Scans full source contents for runtime context

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter src/
evals.expected_output: No flags means scan-only single-pass behavior. The run may warn about incomplete large-scope coverage but must not silently enter loop or mutation mode.

assertions.text: Defaults LOOP_MODE to false
Defaults to scan-only without source edits
Does not imply complete queued coverage merely because one pass ended

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --loop src/
evals.expected_output: Explicit loop mode persists queue/coverage state and continues until every queued scannable file has a terminal outcome or a visible failure interrupts completion.

assertions.text: Sets LOOP_MODE=true only because --loop was requested
Maintains .bug-hunter/coverage.json from per-file evidence
Does not derive a done file solely from a parent chunk marked done
Keeps failed or pending coverage visible

evals.prompt: Use the bug-hunter skill to check my Express API in src/ for real security vulnerabilities. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Natural-language security intent triggers Bug Hunter, maps trust boundaries, and reports evidence-backed security claims without mutation.

assertions.text: Triggers Bug Hunter from natural-language code-audit intent
Maps architecture and trust boundaries before cross-file security claims
Requires a reachable runtime trigger and actionable security evidence
Keeps source read-only

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --fix --approve src/auth/
evals.expected_output: Run adversarial review first, authorize only executable Referee-confirmed remediation, and request reviewed/default host permission for edits without granting commit permission.

assertions.text: Sets reviewed fix/approval mode
Fixer receives only immutable authorized bug IDs and files
Does not infer --auto-commit from edit approval

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter huge-repo/ with an interrupted persisted run
evals.expected_output: Persist chunk state and resume only when run identity and original source baseline still match; changed source must not be silently adopted.

assertions.text: Persists queue/chunk state under .bug-hunter/state.json
Resumes completed work only for matching run identity
Rejects source drift against the original baseline before dispatching resumed work

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter src/ on a repeat run with unchanged evidence
evals.expected_output: Reuse prior deterministic evidence only when exact identity matches; source hash checks remain authoritative before accepting new completion or findings.

assertions.text: Uses content digests for source identity
Allows exact-match cached facts to reduce repeated context work
Does not treat cached facts as current findings or mutation authorization

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter src/ with a malformed delegated payload
evals.expected_output: Payload validation fails before dispatch and cannot be bypassed by free-form fallback output.

assertions.text: Validates the role payload before subagent launch
Does not dispatch malformed payloads
Does not reinterpret a missing canonical artifact as a clean phase

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --fix src/ while another compliant fix run owns the lock
evals.expected_output: Single-writer safety prevents overlapping Fixers and preserves the existing owner lock.

assertions.text: Acquires .bug-hunter/fix.lock before mutation
Stops when a live owner already holds the lock
Does not steal an expired-looking lock from a still-live owner

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --fix src/ with mixed-confidence and mixed-remediation findings
evals.expected_output: The executable fix queue includes only Referee-confirmed findings that meet the effective confidence policy and safe-autofix remediation classification.

assertions.text: Uses the effective configured confidence threshold rather than an unrelated hardcoded value
Keeps low-confidence or conflicting findings in non-executable review
Excludes manual-review, larger-refactor, architectural-remediation, and report-only entries from Fixer scope

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter src/ on an agent runtime with no delegation backend
evals.expected_output: Preflight selects the best available supported backend and uses local-sequential execution when delegation is unavailable.

assertions.text: Selects AGENT_BACKEND from actually available capabilities
Uses local-sequential when no supported delegation backend is available
Does not substitute a fake command that produces no canonical artifact

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter huge-repo/ with a flaky chunk worker
evals.expected_output: Chunk orchestration records each attempt, retries within configured bounds, and never marks a failed assignment complete without valid current evidence.

assertions.text: Uses bounded retry/backoff policy
Writes attempt events to the run journal
Clears stale per-attempt output before retry so an old artifact cannot be accepted

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --deps src/
evals.expected_output: Run supported lockfile-aware dependency auditing and pass reachable dependency evidence to the audit without guessing unsupported ecosystems clean.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/dep-scan.cjs
Writes .bug-hunter/dep-findings.json
Returns scanner-unsupported for ecosystems without a bundled parser rather than no-vulnerability success

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --threat-model src/
evals.expected_output: Generate or reuse Bug Hunter's STRIDE threat-model artifact and feed the resulting trust-boundary context into security analysis.

assertions.text: Uses the bundled threat-model-generation skill when generation is needed
Keeps threat-model artifacts under .bug-hunter
Uses threat-boundary context as evidence, not mutation authority

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --preview src/
evals.expected_output: Preview mode builds remediation strategy/plan output without source edits, commits, or lock-backed mutation.

assertions.text: Treats --preview as the dry-run fix-plan path
Does not edit source or create commits
Keeps generated remediation output distinct from an applied patch

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --autonomous src/
evals.expected_output: Autonomous mode permits unattended eligible edits but still obeys canary-first rollout, immutable scope, verification, circuit-breaker, and rollback rules.

assertions.text: Sets autonomous fix authority explicitly
Uses canary-first bounded rollout
Does not grant commit permission unless --auto-commit is also present

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --pr current
evals.expected_output: Resolve current PR metadata/scope and review the changed source files with the normal adversarial evidence contract.

assertions.text: Uses scripts/pr-scope.cjs
Writes .bug-hunter/pr-scope.json
Scans the resolved changed source files, not the entire repository by default

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --pr recent --scan-only
evals.expected_output: Resolve the most recent PR when metadata is available, retain scan-only authority, and produce normal canonical review artifacts.

assertions.text: Resolves recent PR scope through the PR scope helper
Keeps Fixer disabled because scan-only was requested
Produces Hunter/Referee/scan-report artifacts for the resolved scope

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --plan src/
evals.expected_output: Build fix strategy and plan from confirmed findings, then stop before mutation.

assertions.text: Treats --plan as plan-only behavior
Writes .bug-hunter/fix-strategy.json and .bug-hunter/fix-plan.json
Does not run Fixer edits

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --safe src/
evals.expected_output: Shortcut aliases preserve the underlying permission contract instead of creating new authority semantics.

assertions.text: Treats --safe as --fix --approve
Keeps commit permission separate
Preserves Referee-only and remediation-classification gating

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --pr current with GitHub metadata unavailable and no trustworthy default base
evals.expected_output: Fail PR fallback explicitly instead of silently assuming an arbitrary base branch.

assertions.text: Uses an explicit or trustworthy discovered base for fallback
Fails when no trustworthy base can be determined
Does not silently assume main

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --pr-security
evals.expected_output: Route PR-focused security review through the bundled commit-security-scan workflow with PR scope, threat context, and dependency evidence while remaining read-only.

assertions.text: Loads skills/commit-security-scan/SKILL.md
Combines changed-code scope with threat/dependency context
Keeps Fixer authority disabled

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --security-review src/
evals.expected_output: Route repository security review through the bundled security-review workflow with threat, dependency, adversarial review, and validation semantics.

assertions.text: Loads skills/security-review/SKILL.md
Uses threat-model and dependency context
Does not infer mutation authority from security-review intent

evals.prompt: /bug-hunter --validate-security src/ with confirmed security findings
evals.expected_output: Route focused security validation through the bundled vulnerability-validation skill and enrich exploitability evidence without overriding Referee authority.

assertions.text: Loads skills/vulnerability-validation/SKILL.md
Re-checks reachability, exploitability, PoC quality, and severity evidence
Keeps validation evidence distinct from mutation authorization

evals.prompt: Run Bug Hunter's adaptive runner on a small low-risk target with strong benchmark precision/stability and --adaptive-profile auto.
evals.expected_output: Generate a schema-valid adaptive plan that can choose fast behavior when risk and benchmark evidence justify narrower context/reviewer depth.

assertions.text: Writes .bug-hunter/adaptive-plan.json
Allows auto policy to select fast for small low-risk high-quality conditions
Keeps explicit caller token/chunk/confidence limits authoritative

evals.prompt: Run Bug Hunter's adaptive runner on high-risk security scope with weak recall or calibration evidence.
evals.expected_output: Escalate review/retrieval/verification depth toward assurance while retaining hard source and permission boundaries.

assertions.text: Escalates high-risk or weak-recall security work to deeper policy
Does not use adaptive policy to expand repository scope
Persists the selected policy for reproducibility

evals.prompt: Build a retrieval plan for a suspected authorization bug with mandatory handler/service files, a referenced symbol, dependency graph, and a 12000-token optional-context budget.
evals.expected_output: Keep mandatory direct evidence, rank graph/symbol context by hypothesis relevance, and stop admitting optional context at hard file/token limits.

assertions.text: Writes .bug-hunter/retrieval-plan.json
Keeps mandatory direct evidence even when optional context is constrained
Adds optional dependencies/dependents/trust-boundary context only while budgets permit
Records why each selected item is relevant to a named hypothesis

evals.prompt: Reuse Bug Hunter evidence cache after changing one source byte while preserving size and modification timestamp.
evals.expected_output: Reject stale reuse because cache identity is content-addressed and exact-match only, including protocol/role/options/hypothesis identity.

assertions.text: Uses SHA-256 content identity rather than size/mtime for large files
Rejects cache reuse when exact source content changes
Rejects cache shards that escape the cache root through symlinks

evals.prompt: Run required hybrid verification for a confirmed high-impact finding with a test command, typecheck, and one unavailable required static check.
evals.expected_output: Execute checks as argv without shell interpolation, strip/redact secrets, enforce repository/time/output bounds, and fail closed because a required check is unavailable.

assertions.text: Writes .bug-hunter/verification-report.json
Uses shell:false argv execution and repository-contained working directories
Strips ambient secrets, rejects sensitive env injection, and redacts captured output
Prevents Fixer authorization when a required verification check fails or is unavailable

evals.prompt: Mutate an assigned source file while a Hunter chunk is running, then let the worker return a plausible valid finding.
evals.expected_output: Reject the result and fail the chunk closed because source identity changed between dispatch and commit.

assertions.text: Rechecks source hashes before committing findings/completion
Does not record the stale finding
Does not mark the mutated source covered

evals.prompt: Have a Hunter worker report a finding in a valid repository file that was not in its assigned chunk.
evals.expected_output: Reject the out-of-assignment finding even though the path is inside the repository.

assertions.text: Binds findings to the exact current worker assignment
Does not equate repository containment with worker scope authorization

evals.prompt: Mark a parent chunk done while one assigned file still has pending per-file evidence.
evals.expected_output: Coverage remains pending for the file because per-file evidence is authoritative.

assertions.text: Does not manufacture file completion from parent chunk status
Keeps .bug-hunter/coverage.json truthful at file granularity

evals.prompt: Build Fixer scope from a mix of canary, rollout, manual-review, report-only, and symlink-escaped paths.
evals.expected_output: Authorize only executable canary/rollout entries whose real paths remain inside the repository.

assertions.text: Excludes manual-review and report-only findings from writable Fixer scope
Rejects symlink escapes after realpath containment
Binds scope to repository root, base commit, bug IDs, and files

evals.prompt: Score the bundled benchmark golden runs, then score a noisy run with extra false positives and one missed expected defect.
evals.expected_output: Produce measurable precision/recall/calibration/stability/cost/latency metrics and fail the quality gate for the degraded run.

assertions.text: Writes a schema-valid benchmark-report artifact
Measures precision, recall, F1, severity-weighted recall, calibration, stability, cost/token, latency, and false positives per KLOC where inputs are available
Uses one-to-one matching so one prediction cannot satisfy multiple labels
Fails a degraded/noisy run instead of treating the bundled benchmark as ceremonial

evals.prompt: Change a canonical role skill and forget to regenerate its compatibility prompt copy.
evals.expected_output: Generated-asset validation fails until compatibility prompts are regenerated from canonical skills.

assertions.text: Treats skills/*/SKILL.md as canonical role instructions
Treats generated prompts as compatibility copies rather than independent source of truth
pnpm check:generated detects drift

evals.prompt: Validate a proposed Bug Hunter protocol change before release.
evals.expected_output: Run the full measurable repository gate rather than relying on a small happy-path test subset.

assertions.text: Runs pnpm quality:world-class
Covers generated assets, complete tests, benchmark gate, preflight, and package inventory
Does not call the bundled fixture independent proof of universal superiority
